assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create the FIRST full-screen memory CG for a Chinese 2D narrative game set in a modest small-town courtyard in autumn 1994. Wide cinematic 16:9 composition, single coherent image, no panels or UI. Gentle hand-painted sepia and warm dusty ochre plaster wall, a little exposed brick, soft afternoon courtyard light. In the centre-left, a slender seven-year-old girl with a ponytail stands side-on with her back to the wall, secretly STANDING ON TIPTOES, both heels visibly lifted off the ground. To her right, her 47-year-old grandmother of normal slim build, simple tied-back hair and modest long-sleeved cardigan and trousers, measures the girl's height: one hand holds a flat small book horizontally on top of the girl's head while the other holds a pencil near the wall. Grandmother is an ordinary middle-aged woman, not hunched, not an elderly hospital patient. IMPORTANT: both figures are opaque near-black charcoal silhouettes, readable profiles and hand/foot shapes, very subtle warm rim light, no facial detail, no painted eyes. The feet, lifted heels, book on head and measurement action must be unmistakable. A few small horizontal pencil height ticks on the wall, NO words, numerals or dates. Entire bodies and feet visible; ground visible below heels. Quiet affection and a mischievous child's posture, not melodrama. Small glimpse of sunlit courtyard at far right, with no competing focal point. Natural human anatomy, exactly two people, correct hands, no floating tools. No subtitles, speech balloons, frames, title, logos, text or watermark. Opaque background; fully finished cinematic CG.

Use case: precise-object-edit. This reference is shot 1 of a warm sepia courtyard memory. Create shot 2 as the SAME scene, SAME two charcoal-silhouette characters, clothes, ponytail/bun, proportions, wall, camera position, courtyard and lighting, in the same wide 16:9 frame. Change only the small action: the little girl now stands properly with BOTH FEET FLAT on the paving, heels clearly down, back against the height-mark wall, chin level, looking forward. Grandmother holds the same flat book horizontally resting on the child's head, slightly lower than in the first image, and makes one small pencil height tick on the wall at the book level. Her hands and pencil must be clear and anatomically plausible. Existing old short height ticks remain. Figures stay near-black warm charcoal silhouettes with readable outlines and almost no facial detail, grandma remains a normal slim middle-aged woman, not hunched or obese. The full bodies and both flat feet remain visible. Preserve the reference composition and every background object, no dramatic scene change. Warm quiet family intimacy through posture, no tears. NO writing, dates, numbers, subtitles, UI, balloons, border or watermark. Fully opaque finished CG.

assets.edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only the YOUNG TREE in this memory CG, preserving the two silhouette people, their exact poses, wall, book, courtyard building and upstairs window, warm lighting, all framing and canvas dimensions. The current tree is far too tall for the story. Replace it with a distinctly younger, thinner, shorter osmanthus sapling. Keep its root at approximately image x=1040,y=800 on the same paving, but the VERY TOP of this sapling must be no higher than y=300 pixels on this 1672x941 canvas. Its top should be around y=300-320, its modest green leafy crown approximately 300px wide, trunk slender, golden flowers sparse. This is slightly taller than the little girl, and shorter than the grandmother, with clear air between the sapling top and the high upstairs window whose bottom is around y=220. Essential visual: the young tree has NOT grown to the upstairs window yet, with a clear vertical gap. Keep the thin laundry cord tied loosely around the lower sapling trunk, adjusting the cord only as needed to fit that trunk. Preserve exactly the child's pointing gesture toward the sapling/high window and all other objects. Reconstruct the background wall where the old tall tree was removed. Do not change the large overhead autumn foliage that frames the top of the shot, but keep it visually separate from the little sapling. No words, arrows, captions, UI, border or watermark. Same coherent warm silhouette memory illustration.
